'''Gorno''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] near [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a secret research facility used to design the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] for the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], codenamed [[Hammertong/Legends|Hammertong]]. A [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] there was used as an embarkation point from which the Hammertong was to depart, shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
